europe_now.title: Massive Turnout for Pope Leo XIV in Paris
europe_now.summary: Hundreds of thousands of people gathered in central Paris for an open-air mass led by Pope Leo XIV during his official state visit to France. The pontiff used his engagements to address social cohesion and call for the protection of migrants.

sources.headline: 'A once-in-a-lifetime event': Faithful and curious flock to Pope Leo XIV's Mass in Paris
Pope Leo XIV calls to protect migrants during his official visit to France

europe_now.title: Deadly Building Explosion in Athens
europe_now.summary: A destructive explosion near the Acropolis in Athens resulted in multiple fatalities and missing persons. Emergency responses and investigations into the structural blast are currently underway.

top_stories.title: Papal Visit to France
top_stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV arrived in France for a high-profile state visit, drawing massive crowds to events in Paris. During his tour, he addressed local communities, spoke on secularity, and celebrated a major open-air mass.

top_stories.title: Athens Building Blast
top_stories.summary: An explosion near the Acropolis in Athens caused several deaths and left multiple people unaccounted for. Authorities responded rapidly to the scene as rescue and recovery operations continued.
